script.problem: Moment 2's passage Acts 17:11-12 doesn't include a verse that names Berea in the lessons.

terra.problem: In “Noble-minded Bereans,” “including” makes the prominent Greeks part of the group described as “many of them.” Acts 17:12 says they believed along with that group.
“Noble-minded,” “prominent,” and “proclaiming” may be difficult for a fifth-grade reader. Use simpler words or explain them.
